links.outcome: LLM dietary supplement information extraction performance with versus without retrieval-augmented generation
links.effect: RAG enhanced LLM extraction of dietary supplement information from EHR text. Task-aligned retrieval outperformed reliance on model size or specialization. No numeric results reported in the abstract.
links.quote: We demonstrate that retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) enhances LLMs for dietary supplement (DS) information extraction.

unlisted_practices: Match retrieval strategy to task: structured retrieval for triple extraction, semantic retrieval for classification
Pair smaller general models with optimized retrievers instead of larger or domain-specialized models

screen.practice: retrieval grounding (RAG) added to existing LLMs
screen.reason: The study evaluates adding retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) grounding to LLMs for clinical NLP tasks (dietary supplement extraction from EHRs) versus baseline models without or with different retrieval mechanisms.
